item.title: Overview of Micah - When God Opens the Blinds 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # A teacher once told of walking into a classroom after the students had left for the day. The room looked perfectly normal, desks in neat rows, books stacked, sunlight falling across the floor. But when she opened the blinds fully, she noticed dust floating in the air, crumbs under chairs, and smudges on the whiteboard.

item.title: Overview of Jonah - The Scandalous Mercy of God 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # You know what it is like to carry something quietly, a tension, a reluctance, a calling you did not ask for. It sits in your chest like a weight you keep shifting from one side to the other, hoping it will settle, hoping it will fade. You go about your days, doing what is expected, showing up where you must, but inside there is a conversation you have not finished, a question you have not answered, a nudge from God you have not welcomed.

item.title: Overview of Obadiah - Pride, Judgment, and Deliverance 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # She had never read Obadiah. Perhaps you haven’t either. It is easy to miss, a single page tucked quietly between Amos and Jonah, a book so small you could flip past it without noticing. Most readers never wander into this corner of Scripture. It feels obscure, distant, and, if we’re honest, irrelevant.
